title: 2020 AMC 8 Problem 8
statement: Ricardo has \(2020\) coins, some of which are pennies (\(1\)-cent coins) and the rest of which are nickels (\(5\)-cent coins). He has at least one penny and at least one nickel. What is the difference in cents between the greatest possible and least possible amounts of money that Ricardo can have?

solutions.text:
The greatest value occurs with \(2019\) nickels and \(1\) penny, while the least occurs with \(1\) nickel and \(2019\) pennies.

Between these two cases, \(2018\) pennies have been replaced by nickels. Each replacement adds \(5-1=4\) cents, so the difference is \[ 2018\cdot4=8072 \] cents.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Leave one coin of each type fixed
Changing one penny to one nickel changes the value by \(4\) cents
